description: Adds entries to a Shared Table (need, scope of work, offers, decision, open points, notes) and can tick off or reopen open points by their id from read_table. Needs the full table link including the part after #. The other side sees the change in the browser within a few seconds. Changes by both sides are merged; nothing is overwritten. Only add what the user asked for.

author.description: Name shown with the entries. Default: AICTIONBOT™ Connector.

done.description: Ids of open points to tick off.

entries.description: Entries to add: field and text.

field.description: Field of the table: need, scope, offers, decision, open or notes.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

link.description: The full table link including the part after #.

reopen.description: Ids of open points to open again.

name: add_to_table
title: Add entries to a Shared Table or tick off open points
